'''Matrix boards''' were components installed in [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generators]]. When a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] was overwhelmed by incoming enemy fire, the matrix boards were designed to burn out rather than flood the generator with energy which would result in the destruction of the generator.<ref name="EGWT" />
